setup: local anvil chain and a local git witness; per case a fresh synthetic clinic with a signed note, a released lab result and an allergy written through the API, anchored and published once before the change
browser_check: app.scripts.record_tamper_demo.browser_check, the same steps as packages/receipt-verify verifyRecordCheck and checkRecordAnchor

cases.name: control
cases.browser_detail: all checks pass and the root is on chain

cases.name: row changed
cases.action: one lab value changed in place by the database owner
cases.server_reason: the record differs from its last committed version
cases.browser_detail: record differs from its committed version

cases.name: row, commitment and log rewritten
cases.action: lab value changed, commitment, audit leaf and every later hash recomputed
cases.server_reason: the audit log no longer matches its signed checkpoint
cases.browser_detail: inclusion proof does not reach the signed root
cases.next_anchor: refused: audit log changed since the last checkpoint
cases.witness: 1 of 1 published heads no longer match

cases.name: row deleted
cases.action: the lab result row deleted by the database owner

cases.name: rewritten before its first anchor
cases.action: a new vital changed like case 3, before any anchor covered it
cases.browser_detail: all checks pass and the root is on chain
